# manifold_governance_policy (Resource)

A customer-authored governance policy: a Cedar rule and what happens when it matches. Manifold-managed policies are read-only and cannot be imported.

Updates send the `ETag` from the last refresh as `If-Match`, so a policy edited elsewhere after the plan was made fails the apply instead of being overwritten.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "manifold_governance_policy" "no_prod_db_writes" {
  title       = "Block writes to production databases"
  description = "Agents must not run mutating SQL against production."
  category    = "DATA"
  action      = "correct"
  severity    = "high"
  priority    = 10

  response_message  = "{{ .Title }}: use the staging database or ask the on-call DBA."
  taxonomy_mappings = ["OWASP-ASI02"]

  cedar_policy = <<-EOT
    forbid(principal, action, resource is Event::Tool)
    when {
      resource.input like "*prod-db*" &&
      (resource.input like "*INSERT*" || resource.input like "*UPDATE*" || resource.input like "*DELETE*")
    };
  EOT

  action_options = {
    notify_user = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) What the policy does on a match: `alert`, `advise`, `correct`, `ask`, `block` or `block_session`. `advise` and `correct` require `response_message`.
- `category` (String) One of `ACCESS`, `EXECUTION`, `DATA`, `USAGE`.
- `cedar_policy` (String) The Cedar rule the policy is evaluated from. It must contain a `forbid`; the API type-checks it on write.
- `description` (String) What the policy detects and why it matters.
- `title` (String)

### Optional

- `action_options` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--action_options))
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the policy is evaluated at all. Defaults to `true`.
- `priority` (Number) Attribution order when several blocking policies match one event; the highest supplies the block message. Defaults to `0`.
- `response_message` (String) What the agent is told when the policy blocks, or the directive an `advise`/`correct` policy hands the model. A Go template; the API validates its placeholders.
- `severity` (String) Severity carried by the violations this policy produces: `critical`, `high`, `medium` or `low`. Defaults to `medium`.
- `taxonomy_mappings` (List of String) Framework codes the policy maps to, e.g. `OWASP-ASI02`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) The policy's identifier, a server-assigned UUID.
- `is_managed` (Boolean) Always `false` for a policy managed here.
- `owner` (String) The client that created the policy.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the last change.

<a id="nestedatt--action_options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action_options`

Optional:

- `notify_user` (Boolean) Whether the developer is notified when the policy matches. Defaults to `false`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = manifold_governance_policy.example
  id = "3f0b8c1e-5d2a-4c7e-9b1f-2a6d8e4c0f17"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a customer-authored policy by its UUID.
terraform import manifold_governance_policy.example 3f0b8c1e-5d2a-4c7e-9b1f-2a6d8e4c0f17
```
